verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Haa-meem
Tanzeelul-kitaabi mina Allaahil-azeezil-hakeem
Inna fis-samaawaati wal-ardi la-aayaatin lilmu'mineen
Wa fee khalqikum wa maa yabuththu min daabbatin aayaatun liqawmin yooqinoon
Wakhtilaafil-layli wan-nahaari wa maa anzala Allaahu minas-samaa'i min rizqin fa-ahyaa bihil-arda ba'da mawtihaa wa tasreefir-riyaahi aayaatun liqawmin ya'qiloon
Tilka aayaatu Allaahi natloohaa alayka bil-haqqi fabi'ayyi hadeethin ba'da Allaahi wa aayaatihi yu'minoon
Waylun likulli affaakin atheem
Yasma'u aayaati Allaahi tutlaa alayhi thumma yusirru mustakbiran ka'an lam yasma'haa fabashshirhu bi-adhaabin aleem
Wa idhaa alima min aayaatinaa shay'an ittakhadhahaa huzuwan ulaa'ika lahum adhaabun muheen
Min waraa'ihim jahannamu wa laa yughnee anhum maa kasaboo shay'an wa laa mat-takhadhoo min doonillaahi awliyaa'a wa lahum adhaabun azeem
Haadhaa hudan wal-ladheena kafaroo bi-aayaati rabbihim lahum adhaabun min rijzin aleem
Allaahul-ladhee sakhkhara lakumul-bahra litajriyal-fulku feehi bi-amrihi wa litabtaghoo min fadlihi wa la-allakum tashkuroon
Wa sakhkhara lakum maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi jamee'an minhu inna fee dhaalika la-aayaatin liqawmin yatafakkaroon
Qul lilladheena aamanoo yaghfiroo lilladheena laa yarjoona ayyaama Allaahi liyajziya qawman bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
Man amila saalihan falinafsihi wa man asaa'a fa-alayhaa thumma ilaa rabbikum turja'oon
Wa laqad aataynaa banee israa'eelal-kitaaba wal-hukma wan-nubuwwata wa razaqnaahum minat-tayyibaati wa faddalnaahum alal-aalameen
Wa aataynaahum bayyinaatin minal-amri famakh-talafoo illaa min ba'di maa jaa'ahumul-ilmu baghyan baynahum inna rabbaka yaqdee baynahum yawmal-qiyaamati feemaa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon
Thumma ja'alnaaka alaa sharee'atin minal-amri fattabi'haa wa laa tattabi ahwaa'al-ladheena laa ya'lamoon
Innahum lan yughnoo anka mina Allaahi shay'an wa innaz-zaalimeena ba'duhum awliyaa'u ba'din Wallaahu waliyyul-muttaqeen
Haadhaa basaa'iru lin-naasi wa hudan wa rahmatun liqawmin yooqinoon
Am hasibal-ladheena ijtarahus-sayyi'aati an naj'alahum kal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati sawaa'an mahyaahum wa mamaatuhum saa'a maa yahkumoon
Wa khalaqa Allaahus-samaawaati wal-arda bil-haqqi wa litujzaa kullu nafsin bimaa kasabat wa hum laa yuzlamoon
Afara'ayta manit-takhadha ilahahu hawaahu wa adallahu Allaahu alaa ilmin wa khatama alaa sam'ihi wa qalbihi wa ja'ala alaa basarihi ghishaawatan faman yahdeehi min ba'di Allaahi afalaa tadhakkaroon
Wa qaaloo maa hiya illaa hayaatunad-dunyaa namootu wa nahyaa wa maa yuhlikunaa illad-dahru wa maa lahum bidhaalika min ilmin in hum illaa yazunnoon
Wa idhaa tutlaa alayhim aayaatunaa bayyinaatin maa kaana hujjatahum illaa an qaalu-too bi-aabaa'inaa in kuntum saadiqeen
Quli Allaahu yuhyeekum thumma yumeetukum thumma yajma'ukum ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati laa rayba feehi wa laakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Wa Lillaahi mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa yawma taqoomus-saa'atu yawma'idhin yakhsarul-mubtiloon
Wa taraa kulla ummatin jaathiyatan kullu ummatin tud'aa ilaa kitaabihal-yawma tujzawna maa kuntum ta'maloon
Haadhaa kitaabunaa yantiqu alaykum bil-haqqi innaa kunnaa nastansikhu maa kuntum ta'maloon
Fa-ammal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati fayudkhiluhum rabbuhum fee rahmatihi dhaalika huwal-fawzul-mubeen
Wa ammal-ladheena kafaroo afalam takun aayaatee tutlaa alaykum fastakbartum wa kuntum qawman mujrimeen
Wa idhaa qeela inna wa'da Allaahi haqqun was-saa'atu laa rayba feehaa qultum maa nadree mas-saa'atu in nazunnu illaa zannan wa maa nahnu bimustayqineen
Wa badaa lahum sayyi'aatu maa amiloo wa haaqa bihim maa kaanoo bihi yastahzi'oon
Wa qeelal-yawma nansaakum kamaa naseetum liqaa'a yawmikum haadhaa wa ma'waakumun-naaru wa maa lakum min naasireen
Dhaalikum bi-annakum ittakhadhtum aayaati Allaahi huzuwan wa gharratkumul-hayaatud-dunyaa fal-yawma laa yukhrajoona minhaa wa laa hum yusta'taboon
Falillaahil-hamdu rabbis-samaawaati wa rabbil-ardi rabbil-aalameen
Wa lahul-kibriyaa'u fis-samaawaati wal-ardi wa huwal-azeezul-hakeem
